Blood Warden.description_en: A shielded warrior who strikes back with raw plasma force.
Blood Warden.description_es: Un guerrero blindado que contraataca con fuerza de plasma pura.

Frostbane Arcanist.description_en: A cursed archer who fires shadow-tipped arrows from afar.
Frostbane Arcanist.description_es: Arquero maldito que dispara flechas sombrías desde la distancia.

Liora Sunveil.description_en: A divine priestess channeling celestial light to heal and smite.
Liora Sunveil.description_es: Una sacerdotisa divina que canaliza luz celestial para sanar y castigar.

Tharnok the Verdant.description_en: Nature-bound knight who thrives on regeneration and retaliation.
Tharnok the Verdant.description_es: Caballero vinculado a la naturaleza que se regenera y contraataca.
